answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: voting rights require economic embedding, not mass production. A newcomer must complete paid work for eight distinct counterparties over three epochs. One job may forecast a zephyr, another map karst drainage, a third inspect a lotus harvest. Faking 1,000 identities thus needs 8,000 genuine relationships at 10 POA each, 80,000 POA total. An honest agent pays once, for eight jobs, and votes undiluted by fakes.
